title: ASARS Kinetic-UAS Profile v0.1-draft
description: ASARS payload extension for unmanned kinetic-capable platforms. Draft — ITAR/EAR may apply to implementations; this document is general specification text only.

kinetic_context.description: Platform and RoE context at the kinetic decision demarcation point.

flight_controller.description: Flight or motion controller stack identifier (e.g. PX4/ArduPilot family label).

roe_policy_hash.description: SHA-256 of active RoE policy artifact (reference only — do not embed controlled text).

roe_policy_version.description: Version or digest label of the RoE artifact.

hitl_authorized_by.description: Authorizing human or command role reference when applicable.

hitl_timestamp.description: UTC time of human authorization when applicable.

command_disposition.description: Domain disposition. Map to core outcome: executed with compliant RoE→allowed; blocked / violation / emergency→blocked; escalated→blocked until cleared per policy.

outcome.description: Core ASARS result at observation time.

notes: Draft only. Seek review from DoD autonomy / JAG-adjacent audit practitioners before non-draft publication. Implementations on weapons systems require separate export-control and classification review.
